story_templates._readme: Video-scout footage plans per story type. Each role gets its own searches; NOW prefers official channels/trailers, THEN prefers original-era gameplay/commercials/archive. Velocity is only a tiebreaker WITHIN a role. Titles/channels suggesting commentary (reaction, explained, 'my thoughts', news recap) are strongly penalized — footage beats talking heads.
